title: Adolescent Chatbot
official: Improving Access to Services, Preventing Eating Disorders, and Addressing Comorbid Depression and Anxiety in Diverse Adolescents
summary: The purpose of this study is to test an eating disorders prevention digital chatbot program in a diverse group of adolescents.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

1. 13 - 19 years old
2. Owns a smartphone
3. Speaks English
4. US resident
5. Screens as at-risk for an eating disorder
6. Not currently in treatment for an eating disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Below 13 or older than 19 years of age
2. Does not own a smartphone
3. Does not speak English
4. Lives outside the US
5. Screens as:

   1. Having a subclinical or clinical ED
   2. Not at risk for an ED
   3. In treatment for an ED
